key_entities: CI is a venue, not a dependency
propositions: The portability invariant criterion must detect and flag capabilities whose sole trigger is a specific CI provider (e.g., GitHub Actions only) without an operation-linked or in-process fallback, as such designs break on projects with no CI provider.

The criterion's Platform and venue matrix cell currently lists an undifferentiated 'CI' venue, leaving 'projects with NO CI provider at all' and 'CI under any provider' unnameable as alternate shapes, so no finding fires when a plan depends on a single CI system.

The authoritative rubric text, detection rule, and all mirrors (docs, tests, agent guidance) must be synchronized: the new matrix cell and no-CI-provider rule must appear in the prompt, be pinned by unit tests, reflected in the docs mirror, and surfaced in AGENTS.md.

Live A/B testing on a scratch plan with GitHub-Actions-only compaction scheduling confirms that the updated rubric emits a project.portability finding naming both alternate shapes, whereas the pre-change rubric emitted none.
